status: Partial Ophidia content implemented; explicit calibration required for recent-use seconds and PvP damage, synthetic skill/dodge producers
requirements: Solar melee gets an extra charge.
All melee charges recharge simultaneously, with an unspecified recent-use exception.
Throwing Knife kills grant three five-second damage stacks; Gambler dodge refreshes the active duration.

official_context.claim: Lightweight Knife extra charge did not stack with Ophidia Spathe because of its distinct recharge behavior. Historical context, not verification of all current exotic behavior.

core_demonstration.policy: Separate available-use and single-cycle progress accounts; explicit atomic completion fills the former and resets the latter. Partial progress cannot pay a use.
core_demonstration.ability_route: AbilityDefinition.recharge_resource now separates slot-based gains from usable cost energy; original Pugilist, Wellspring and Surplus definitions compose with the synthetic linked ability. Already-full usable accounts reject further routed progress.

equipment_cycle_yield.policy: One persistent uses/progress pair supports both sequential and linked completion. A completion-time Profile changes optional complete_recharge.amount from one to the current missing uses; physical equipment changes retain progress. Capacity is independent.
equipment_cycle_yield.boundary: Generic source/Buff composition and actual equipment proof only. Does not establish original Ophidia equip/reset or recent-use behavior; no automatic migration of legacy single-account abilities.

selected_capacity.policy: Resolve the current base selection at execution and resize its usable cost account only. Empty, costless and fixed-capacity selections return distinct nonnumeric outcomes before evaluating capacity. The separate recharge meter and unselected accounts are unchanged.
selected_capacity.composition: Synthetic SOURCE and selection rules read the final source set, preserve balance on equivalent physical equipment replacement, and recompute retained accounts when reselected. Delayed actions use the selection at execution; temporary cast replacements do not redirect capacity.
selected_capacity.boundary: Generic engine capability only; the synthetic 2/3 capacities, 0.5/s cycle and healing observations do not implement or calibrate Ophidia Spathe.

unresolved: Recent-use seconds, one-charge exception yield, cycle reset, equip/unequip, shared-account selection and initial-charge policies require original-game calibration.
Current PvP damage table remains unverified. The synthetic 11/22/33 percent values are acceptance inputs, not fallback game values.

Actual Solar knife catalogue, physical knife flight/precision/explosion producers, full Gambler dodge displacement/near-enemy eligibility and class/subclass restrictions are not implemented by these synthetic producers.

Damage on-hit sampling, posthumous/in-flight source swaps, precise throwing-knife kill credit (including secondary explosions) and dedup retention beyond its bounded receipt bucket require original-game interaction review.
Formal production equipment/subclass assembly, arbitrary linked groups, parallel lanes, legacy-account migration, active-state persistence, HUD and visuals remain incomplete.

official_damage_context.claim: Maximum PvE Throwing Knife damage bonus increased from 100% to 200%. This supports the current PvE maximum, not a complete current PvP table.
official_damage_context.historical_claim: The 2023 update introduced three five-second knife-kill stacks with 30/60/100 percent and dodge refresh; do not substitute this historic table for currently uncalibrated PvP values or override current Compendium Gambler dodge qualification.
official_damage_context.additive_claim: Melee bonuses add; Melee stat remains multiplicative. Ordinary melee bonuses do not scale melee-generated Scorch/Ignition. Reopened 2026-10-11.

content.eligibility: Current selected ability carries the combined chorus_d2:solar_melee source tag; no element/melee qualification inferred from separate unrelated sources. Knife kills need owned confirmed death plus melee_kill and throwing_knife_kill credit. Dodge refresh requires explicit gamblers_dodge ability tag.
content.capacity: Input 1 plus MAX family of selected intrinsic extra and exotic extra. Native two-charge knife plus Ophidia remains two; independent future families may add further charges. This is not an engine-wide cap.
content.initialization: Shared usable resource first initializes at 2/2, then selection source immediately computes current capacity. Ordinary Solar first selection clips to 1/1; intrinsic double first selection retains 2/2. Subsequent expansion preserves absolute balance and grants no energy.
content.recharge: One persistent Solar uses/progress pair. Selected SOURCE supplies base rate/CES/intrinsic extra, current Melee stat fit scales rate and base gains. Empty/non-Solar selection pauses this pair. Ordinary cycle yields one; equipped Ophidia outside recent-use window yields current missing. Within the window yields one: explicit uncalibrated exception policy, not a measured claim.
content.reset: First spend from full resets progress; additional spending preserves it. Equipment/selection changes retain progress, shrinking clips usable balance; unselected accounts are not migrated or resized until reselected.
content.damage: PvE deltas .67/1.33/2, three shared five-second stacks, on-hit current source evaluation, additive with existing melee families. Same Ophidia MAX family prevents duplicate equipped sources adding multiple bonuses. Excludes explicit scorch_damage and ignition_damage even if input also carries knife/melee tags.
content.lifecycle: Capped kills reset five-second expiry; Gambler dodge only refreshes existing stacks. Fixed non-refreshing five-second shared death-ID bucket deduplicates concurrent source reactions. Equivalent full-set source replacement retains Buffs; removing the last tagged source or holder death clears all three Buffs. No permanent replay ledger.
content.parameters: recent_use_seconds SECOND and pvp_one/two/three DELTA must be bound explicitly. Equipment instance schema requires positive seconds and nonnegative deltas; generic SOURCE parameters enforce presence/units, not semantic ranges. Invalid direct-source duration fails when its action executes, not before the original ability payment.

synthetic_values.ability_body: heal 1 as an observable paid world action, not knife behavior
